blocker.detail: The preregistered harness requires Python 3. Windows resolved the python command to the Microsoft Store execution alias rather than a usable Python runtime.
blocker.authority: Installing Python is outside the current one-off authorization, which allowed system changes only for Ollama.
blocker.resolution_requires: Either explicit new authorization to install a bounded Python runtime while preserving LOCAL-AI-CODER-001 unchanged, or a separately preregistered new benchmark if the runtime is redesigned. Do not silently alter LOCAL-AI-CODER-001 scoring.

learning: Prerequisite/runtime checks must happen before large model downloads. The runner should verify a real Python interpreter and reject Windows Store aliases before pulling the model.
truth_limit: The shared terminal log is direct user-provided execution evidence, not independent remote readback. It proves neither benchmark quality nor LOCAL_AI promotion.
